DIV8.HEAD: § 99.10 Nested paragraphs.
DIV8.P: (a) Scope. (1)(i) First child printed inside paragraph (a).
(i) Italic roman under the italic number.
An unmarked paragraph keeps the depth of the one before it.
DIV8.FP-1: A flush paragraph, indented one level.
